name: VortX
subtitle: Native streaming app for Apple, on stremio-core + libmpv.

apps.name: VortX
apps.subtitle: Stream movies and shows on iPhone and iPad.
apps.localizedDescription: VortX is a native, open-source streaming app for Apple devices, built on the official stremio-core engine and the libmpv player. Multi-profile, HDR and Dolby Vision, skip intro and outro, stream ranking, in-app add-ons and debrid keys, and more. Sideload-friendly: this source delivers one-tap updates so you never re-download an IPA by hand.

versions.localizedDescription: Re-find sources when a title's links go stale, plus a 4K HDR seek-stutter fix.

0.3.14 Beta 17. Source picking and scrub previews fixed, on-device usenet with your own provider, smoother scrubbing and next episode, and an add-on setup fix. In-place update over any earlier build, nothing resets.
0.3.14 Beta 16. One-tap update over any earlier build, nothing resets.

0.3.14 Beta 15. A focused playback-reliability wave from a full diagnostic-log audit. Streams that spun forever now recover on their own, a dead source is dropped in a couple of seconds instead of half a minute, marking something watched shows up right away, rewinding keeps working on long streams, and an unsafe Dolby Vision colour fallback is corrected. Trakt sign-in works again, no app update needed. In-place update over any earlier build, nothing resets.

0.3.14 Beta 14. The big one since Beta 12. The playback-stability campaign that fixes the Beta 12 constant-buffering regression plus a long list of stalls, freezes, and crashes traced on real Apple devices, a full account and credential security pass, audio and Continue Watching fixes, and deeper diagnostics. In-place update over any earlier build, nothing resets.

0.3.14 Beta 12. Two hotfixes over Beta 10. The app opens again: a keychain locking deadlock that froze the splash screen on signed-in installs (worst on Apple TV) is fixed. External debrid playback works again: a TLS enforcement shipped with no certificate trust store, which blocked every Real-Debrid and TorBox source while local torrents played, is removed. In-place update over any earlier build, nothing resets.

0.3.14 Beta 10. Fresh episodes now start at 0:00 (fixes the few-seconds-in start), remux playback and seeking are hardened, a large Android and web settings-sync pass lands, and trusted media transport is enforced at the app layer. In-place update over Beta 9, nothing resets.

0.3.14 Beta 9. Use a Mac as the engine, true Dolby Vision including Profile 7 enhancement layer, Dolby Atmos passthrough, Blu-ray subtitles, our own player engine, tvOS Now Playing, and working QR sign-in.
